target.doc: the thing acted on or asked about

fill.head: class
fill.src: how an existing target is given

kind.head: candidate
kind.src: std.request.target.kind (candidates: kinds of the area + knowledge kind tree)

count.head: number
count.src: how many new things / how many selected

constraint.doc: one condition on a target (selector or desired result)

step.head: step
step.src: degree words: bigger, a bit warmer, much later

variety.head: class
variety.src: constraint across members (two different houses, random colours)

negated.head: span
negated.src: std.request.not: words of the negated condition

question.doc: what is asked (pending contract: question projection)

asked_key.head: candidate
asked_key.src: which key is asked: 'what colour is it' -> colour

fragment.head: class
fragment.src: book 6.4: fragments complete the previous request

objection.head: class
objection.src: book 6.11.1 objections about the previous reply

area.head: class
area.src: which area a cross-area request points to (send a chart to the document)

anchor.head: fill+span
anchor.src: the other thing of the relation

distanceGrade.head: candidate
distanceGrade.src: Authored semantic intent; requires world-informed completion

part.doc: a part of a drawn thing (petal, roof, window, wheel)

kind.head: candidate
kind.src: startDiagram kind; charts are a kind of diagram

node.doc: a node / box / bar / slice (book 7.2 t.node)

relation.head: candidate
relation.src: Authored semantic intent; requires world-informed completion

source.head: class+span
source.src: chart.fromList/fromHoldings/...; book: meetings per person from the calendar

text.doc: a document as a whole (book 7.3 t.text)

section.doc: a part of a document (book 7.3 t.section)

content.head: span
content.src: text the user dictates to insert/replace (doc.addParagraph, doc.dictate)

day.head: candidate+span
day.src: s.meet.start part=start (day): today, tomorrow, weekday, date, next week

time.head: candidate+span+step
time.src: s.meet.start (clock or region morning/afternoon; step earlier/later)

timezone.head: candidate
timezone.src: Authored explicit temporal intent; native epoch normalization remains completion
